plan.package_readme:
# Melezitose #901 execution evidence

This completed selection records the actual source correction, native candidate-v2 generation, bounded canonical promotion and approval-free receipt20, original primary-source captures, historical upstream provenance, exact prior approval withdrawal, completed scientific three-claim review, and final SSSOM diagnostics. Selection and integrity verification add no scientific approval or supervisor binding. Package freeze/publication still require root and independent approval of these exact bytes.

Durable MIM base is e568dbf0e0f759431ed317b973675680f031dd1d. Unchanged individual ingredient owners resolve to verified regular Git blobs at that base. Changed aggregate YAML and other selected changed inputs are intentionally archived; this includes the changed mapped aggregate, whose exact bytes remain necessary for receipt replay. Changed and historical versions retain their original absolute path and SHA-256 identity, with immutable byte-source captures kept separately. A shallow recipient must fetch this public base. Generation's recorded feature checkpoint and merged Claw producer 9bd09b2 are historical execution attribution, not required MIM portability ancestors.

The guarded source correction changes one monohydrate owner from CLOSE_MATCH to NARROW_MATCH, preserving CAS identity, chemistry, aliases, counts and provisional role. Canonical changes are two existing rows and one added B1 row (2981 to 2982): parent broadMatch, retained exact CAS, and the subject's local compound handle. Receipt20 grants no approval. Only after all three claims were explicitly WITHHOLD did the separate scientific review assess those exact owner/row bytes. Its truthful self-review qualification and independent adversarial review are preserved. The original upstream manifest 9bb29d56 and captures document historical source vocabulary; they are not current scientific authority.

The diagnostic review has scientific_review=false. It reports zero native rejects, no reconciliation drift, the retained RuleK baseline, actual B4 validation on five present tables with missing BTO/MICRO coverage, 101 unchanged curator-label warnings, 23 deferred RuleK entries and 18 legacy subject misses resolved by the maintained codec. Original failed generator attempts and the wrapper's incorrect count of 36 metadata lines are retained with corrections.

The full graph scientific release remains **FAIL**, with 1,732 blocking findings and 2,334 blocking assertions. The separately reviewed SSSOM subset has 1,741 SUPPORTED and 1,241 WITHHOLD rows; supported KGX validates 2,153 approved edges. Successful integrity/generation commands do not mean that the full graph passed scientific review. The melezitose carbon role and both historical role/whole-record findings remain OPEN. No sodium curation or prospective approval is included.

The final full `just test` passes:4,196 passed, 1 skipped, 33 warnings in 1018.41 seconds; maintained-package coverage 75%. Final `just qc` passes. The 458 source/test/producer hashes were captured at 21:00:18.499748Z, after tests launched at 20:59:52.830001Z and QC at 20:59:53.991124Z, under the recorded no-edit hold. All 458 captured hashes matched at completion; earlier source freezes are separately preserved. This after-launch snapshot does not by itself observe the interval before capture. Scopev2 records 77 actual owned PR paths before execution-package publication; exactly one scientific owner changed. Full-test log SHA256 25b2c152c21ed4df4a1c4d4b38fd2bb6ed3f81327bc3a5a7d494745906f9134d; QC log SHA256 a53e6370f2739bde96340c50cfba8721b6d69d6fbc95eb509e65701d327211c2.

Confirmed #1074 follow-up fixed ignored explicit manifest pins for absent/unchanged manifests, with red regressions, 87 focused passing tests, mutation controls, and independent re-review. Old utility 45bb/test e9e6 snapshots and the original companion audit remain immutable. The repaired ace0 producer creates a distinct companion at reports/ingredient_bundle_20261101_melezitose901_pin1074 with audit e7c0; review 2fb81336 and export manifest c886ce4b remain byte-identical. Its 20 owners and 51 claims were not scientifically reapproved. Native export/validation and independent four-class comparison pass, preserving all unrelated decisions and reviewed companion payloads. Actual selector edits and their exact preimages are retained; qc-evidence.yaml is unchanged.

The initial full suite failed one synthetic carnitine fixture (4,189 passed, 1 skipped). The first root and independent focused checks still lacked its native FORM module input after registry isolation. #1075 now captures that input in the reduced fixture, preserves owner-only withdrawal/failure/positive assertions, and passes 101 author-focused tests, 19 independent-focused tests and the final full suite. Production FORM admission and integration tests remain active. All failed receipts/logs remain selected with explicit dispositions. Reviewer harness failures involving error formatting or an accurately added docs sentence are distinguished from production defects and followed by successful exact checks.

The read-only staging harness initially rejected raw Git-index cache-byte change during concurrent checks. Its retained retry compares actual staged entries and cached diff, proving no staging changed. A whitespace diagnostic identifies a required empty ninth TSV cell as trailing whitespace; the selected audit verifies nine columns and clean non-TSV diffs. The native TSV delimiter was preserved.

The package verifier checks selected bytes, historical identities, command/log bindings and optional current scope. It does not replay external scientific sources or all generation prerequisites. KG-Microbe, CultureMech comparison corpora and ontology databases remain explicit omitted prerequisites with captured hashes/sizes/roles; BTO, MICRO and the optional residual retain genuine absence evidence. Caches, environments, Git internals, temporary fixtures and bulky graph products are excluded. No recursive report/environment sweep was used.

Receipt20 retains one literal historical operator identity containing ../. The selected receipt20-literal-origin-aliases-v1.json binds that exact spelling/hash to a safe separately selected operator identity. The generic verifier does not directly resolve the unsafe literal spelling; it verifies the binding document and safe bytes. Neither the historical receipt nor path safety changed. Two ordinary receipt input identities are also retained under their exact original names. See the selected issue-comment body and https://github.com/CultureBotAI/MediaIngredientMech/issues/1073#issuecomment-6563603548.

Earlier draft statements and historical PASS/failure reports describe their original versions, not final state. This README and final gate receipts state the completed prepublication evidence. Independent review of this exact final selection, package publication validation, final committed-head review and CI occur afterward, outside the package's own selected inputs to avoid self-binding. No merge, branch cleanup or final-head approval is claimed here.
